name: Email Triage — AI Inbox Classifier + Draft Replies (Forethinq Labs)

parameters.content:
## Email Triage - AI Inbox Classifier + Draft Replies
**Flow:** Gmail trigger (new unread mail) -> extract fields -> dedupe lookup by message ID -> Gemini classify (URGENT / NEEDS_REPLY / FYI / PROMO) -> apply the matching Gmail label -> for NEEDS_REPLY, a second Gemini call drafts a reply and saves it as a Gmail DRAFT (never sent) -> every outcome is logged to the sheet, including duplicates and invalid mail. Bad AI output or a failed AI call goes to a Needs Review log row plus an alert email - never a silent default category.

**Before first run (see repo README):**
1. Connect your Google account in the Gmail trigger, ALL Google Sheets nodes (Lookup, Log x4), the label node, the draft node, and the alert node. Point every Sheets node at your log sheet (replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID). The sheet needs a tab named `Processed` with these headers in row 1: Received At | Message ID | From | Subject | Category | Summary | Status | Reason | Label Applied | Draft Status | Draft ID.
2. In Gmail, create 4 labels: Triage/URGENT, Triage/NEEDS REPLY, Triage/FYI, Triage/PROMO. In the "Apply Category Label" node, replace YOUR_LABEL_ID_URGENT / YOUR_LABEL_ID_NEEDS_REPLY / YOUR_LABEL_ID_FYI / YOUR_LABEL_ID_PROMO with the real label IDs (or pick each label from the list when you import - the expression in that node picks the ID by category).
3. In BOTH Gemini HTTP nodes, replace `YOUR_GEMINI_API_KEY` in the **x-goog-api-key header** (free key from Google AI Studio). The key never goes in the URL.
4. Replace `YOUR_EMAIL@example.com` in the Needs-Review Alert node with the owner's email.
5. Error workflow: import `workflow-error-handler.json` first, open it, copy its workflow ID, then in THIS workflow go to Settings and replace `REPLACE_WITH_ERROR_WORKFLOW_ID` in the Error Workflow field with that ID. The exported file cannot carry the real ID - it belongs to your n8n instance.

**Dedupe key and limits:**
- Key = the Gmail message ID, stored in the log sheet on every outcome. The lookup is a filtered read on that one ID - it does not read every row.
- Rows logged with Status `Invalid` do NOT count as processed (mirrors Demo 1), so a mail that failed field validation can be picked up again if it is re-polled. Every other status (Processed, Duplicate, Needs Review) counts, so a mail is never classified or labelled twice.
- Limit: two polls landing in the same moment can both pass the lookup before either writes its log row. Rare with a 1-minute poll; the log sheet shows it if it happens.

**Failure behaviour (by design):**
- Every outside call (Gemini x2, Sheets, Gmail x3) retries 3 times. After that: Sheets write failures stop the run loudly (Stop nodes + error workflow); a failed dedupe lookup or AI call sends the email down the Needs Review path instead.
- AI output is validated field by field. A bad category or an empty summary NEVER becomes a default category - the email is logged as Needs Review and gets its own alert.
- A Gmail label failure does not lose the email: it is still classified, drafted if needed, and logged with Label Applied = No.
- Replies are DRAFTS only. This workflow never sends a reply. A human reads, edits, and sends.
- Email text goes into both AI prompts between EMAIL_DATA_START / EMAIL_DATA_END markers and is treated as data, not commands. Bodies are cut at 4,000 characters for the prompts.

nodes.name: New Mail Arrives
nodes.notes: Polls the connected Gmail inbox every minute for new mail. Extract & Validate Fields reads the raw Gmail message shape (headers + base64 body parts). Restrict the trigger to a label in its filters if you only want part of the inbox triaged.

nodes.name: Lookup Processed Mail
nodes.notes: Lookup, not a full read: the Message ID filter returns only log rows for this exact Gmail message ID. Dedupe Check then confirms the match and ignores rows logged as Invalid.

value.Subject: ={{ $json.subject }}
value.Reason: Duplicate - this message ID is already in the log; not classified or labelled again

nodes.name: AI Classify — Gemini

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: $json.promptText }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.2, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}

nodes.notes: Gemini key travels in the x-goog-api-key header, never in the URL. Model: gemini-3.1-flash-lite. Replace YOUR_GEMINI_API_KEY with your key (free, from Google AI Studio) - or swap this header for an n8n Header Auth credential.

nodes.name: Mark Needs Review - AI Call Failed
Apply Category Label — Gmail
nodes.notes: Adds the Gmail label matching the AI category. The label ID is picked by expression - replace the four YOUR_LABEL_ID_* placeholders with the real IDs of your Triage labels (or re-pick the label here after import). A failure here does not lose the email: it flows on with Label Applied = No and is still logged.

nodes.notes: Second Gemini call, only for NEEDS_REPLY mail. Same header-auth rule: key in the x-goog-api-key header, never in the URL. The output is validated and saved as a Gmail DRAFT - this workflow never sends a reply.

const j = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: {
  receivedAt: j.receivedAt || new Date().toISOString(),
  messageId: j.messageId || '', from: j.from || '', subject: j.subject || '', body: j.body || '',
  category: j.category || '', summary: j.summary || '',
  reason: j.reason || 'Needs review - unspecified triage failure',
  next_action: j.next_action || 'Open the email and triage it by hand',
  ai_ok: false, status: 'Needs Review',
  ai_error: j.ai_error || j.reason || '',
  label_applied: j.label_applied || false,
  draft_status: j.draft_status || 'Not created - needs review',
  draft_id: '' } }];

parameters.errorMessage: A Google Sheets write failed after 3 tries, so an email outcome was NOT logged. The email data is in this execution - fix the Sheets connection and re-run, or log it by hand. The email itself is safe in Gmail.
The Needs-Review Gmail alert failed after 3 tries. The email is logged in the Processed sheet with Status "Needs Review" - fix the Gmail connection and alert by hand.
